about: ArcWest Exploration Inc. engages in the exploration of mineral properties in Canada. It primarily explores for copper and gold deposits. The company holds 100% interests in the Todd Creek property covering an area of 21,720 hectares located near the northeast of Stewart; the Oweegee Dome property that covers an area of 31,077 hectares located near the east of Tudor Gold's Treaty Creek; the Oxide Peak property; and the Rip property, which situated in south of Houston. It also has interests in the Teeta Creek property located in northern Vancouver Island, British Columbia; the Northern Vancouver Island property located in northern Vancouver; Sparrowhawk project that covers an area of 10,006 hectares located in southeast of the Morrison Cu deposit; and the Eagle property located in northern Vancouver Island, British Columbia. The company was formerly known as Sojourn Exploration Inc. and changed its name to ArcWest Exploration Inc. in February 2019. ArcWest Exploration Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
